mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventories (book_id, available_quantity, reserved_quantity, sold_quantity, version) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{availableQuantity}, 0, 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE inventories SET available_quantity = available_quantity - #{quantity}, reserved_quantity = reserved_quantity + #{quantity}, version = version + 1 WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND available_quantity >= #{quantity}
